installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Optimized SRCDS Installation Script with Retries

# Configuration
MAX_RETRIES=3
BASE_URL="http://ggc-cs.com/csbuild"
GITHUB_API="https://api.github.com/repos"

# Install dependencies (no retries needed as these are from package repos)
dpkg --add-architecture i386
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl wget file tar bzip2 gzip jq unzip ca-certificates \
    lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6
apt-get clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Setup server directory
rm -rf /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

# Download function with retries
download_with_retry() {
    local url=$1
    local output=$2
    local retries=0
    
    while [ $retries -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
        if wget -q -O "$output" "$url"; then
            return 0
        fi
        ((retries++))
        echo "Retry $retries/$MAX_RETRIES for $url"
        sleep 2
    done
    echo "Failed to download $url after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
    return 1
}

# Download and extract base files
if ! download_with_retry "$BASE_URL/rehlds_linux_server.zip" "rehlds_linux_server.zip"; then
    exit 1
fi
unzip -q -o rehlds_linux_server.zip
rm -f rehlds_linux_server.zip

# Optimized GitHub release installer
install_github_release() {
    local repo=$1
    local match=$2
    local version=$3
    local target_dir=$4
    local retries=0
    local download_url
    
    while [ $retries -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
        if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" == "latest" ]; then
            download_url=$(curl -sf "$GITHUB_API/$repo/releases/latest" | \
                jq -r ".assets[] | select(.name | test(\"$match\"; \"i\")).browser_download_url")
        else
            download_url=$(curl -sf "$GITHUB_API/$repo/releases" | \
                jq -r --arg version "$version" \
                '.[] | select(.tag_name == $version).assets[] | select(.name | test("'"$match"'"; "i")).browser_download_url')
        fi
        
        if [ -n "$download_url" ] && download_with_retry "$download_url" "/tmp/${match}.zip"; then
            unzip -q -o "/tmp/${match}.zip" -d /tmp
            if [ -n "$target_dir" ]; then
                cp -r "/tmp/bin/linux32/$target_dir"/* "/mnt/server/$target_dir/"
            else
                cp -r /tmp/bin/linux32/* /mnt/server/
            fi
            rm -f "/tmp/${match}.zip"
            return 0
        fi
        ((retries++))
        echo "Retry $retries/$MAX_RETRIES for $repo release"
        sleep 2
    done
    echo "Failed to install $repo release after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
    return 1
}

# Install components
if [[ -n "$INSTALL_COMPONENTS" ]]; then
    [[ "$INSTALL_COMPONENTS" == *"rehlds"* ]] && \
        install_github_release "rehlds/ReHLDS" "rehlds-bin" "$VERSION"
    
    [[ "$INSTALL_COMPONENTS" == *"regamedll"* ]] && \
        install_github_release "rehlds/ReGameDLL_CS" "regamedll-bin" "$GAME_VERSION" "cstrike"
    
    [[ "$INSTALL_COMPONENTS" == *"reapi"* ]] && \
        install_github_release "rehlds/ReAPI" "reapi-bin" "$REAPI_VERSION" && \
        cp -r /tmp/addons/amxmodx/modules/* /mnt/server/cstrike/addons/amxmodx/modules/
fi

# SteamIdHashSalt generation (optimized one-liner)
sed -i "s/^SteamIdHashSalt\s*=.*/SteamIdHashSalt = $(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 32)/" \
    /mnt/server/cstrike/reunion.cfg 2>/dev/null || \
echo "SteamIdHashSalt = $(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 32)" >> /mnt/server/cstrike/reunion.cfg

# ====== FastDL (only sv_downloadurl) ======
FINAL_FASTDL="${FASTDL_URL}/${P_SERVER_UUID}/cstrike/"
if grep -qE '^\s*sv_downloadurl\s*' /mnt/server/cstrike/server.cfg 2>/dev/null; then
    sed -i "s#^\s*sv_downloadurl\b.*#sv_downloadurl \"${FINAL_FASTDL}\"#" /mnt/server/cstrike/server.cfg
else
    echo "sv_downloadurl \"${FINAL_FASTDL}\"" >> /mnt/server/cstrike/server.cfg
fi

# Final setup
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
chmod +x hlds_{run,linux}
export HOME=/mnt/server
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/lib/i386-linux-gnu:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64

# Link steamclient.so for 32-bit
if [ -f linux32/steamclient.so ]; then
    cp -f linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
elif [ -f steamclient.so ]; then
    cp -f steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
fi

# Link steamclient.so for 64-bit
if [ -f linux64/steamclient.so ]; then
    cp -f linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
elif [ -f steamclient.so ]; then
    cp -f steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
fi

# Cleanup
rm -rf /tmp/{bin,*.zip}
chmod 750 /mnt/server/
echo "Installation complete"

variables.name: Ping Boost
variables.description:
Adjusts the server sleep policy to control CPU usage and FPS.
0: (Default) Standard 1ms sleep. Minimal CPU usage.
1: (Linux only) Uses setitimer for a 1ms sleep cycle.
2: (Linux only) Uses poll instead of legacy select for a 1ms sleep.
3: Original engine implementation (NET_Sleep_Timeout). Unchanged behavior.
4: Aggressive boost. CPU sleeps for 1 microsecond, higher FPS. Linux and Windows.
5: Maximum performance. Server thread yields instead of sleeping. 100% CPU core load.
